title: Gate G01 capability: governed badf-prd definition, challenge, completeness and baseline-evidence preparation
objective: Implement the first lifecycle-specific BADF skill for Gate G01 so product intent can be converted into a structurally complete, challenge-tested, evidence-ready PRD candidate without allowing the skill to self-issue PRD_BASELINED.
business_value: Creates a repeatable product-definition control at the start of delivery, reducing ambiguity and preventing incomplete or self-approved PRDs from advancing into requirement decomposition.
in_scope: BADF delivery routing integration and skill registration as a non-active implementation source
Gate G01 demand/work-package traceability and integrity lockfile update
out_of_scope: issuing PRD_BASELINED or changing gate authority
G02 requirement decomposition and Gates G03-G14 implementation
vendoring or executing GitHub Spec Kit, platform-product-skills, Product on Purpose, or Matt Pocock external scripts
production deployment or direct writes to main
acceptance_criteria: badf-prd defines product definition, completeness, challenge, and baseline-evidence preparation for G01
validator fails closed on missing fields, contradictions, unresolved placeholders, duplicate JSON keys and invalid approval records
validator returns REWORK_REQUIRED for blocking challenge findings or unresolved decisions
complete candidate returns ELIGIBLE_FOR_G01_REVIEW with NO_GATE_AUTHORITY and never PRD_BASELINED
objective metric_refs resolve to declared success metrics and scope cannot contain the same item on both sides
approved baseline requires independent product_owner identity, timestamp and evidence refs; candidate author cannot self-approve
external methodology is reference-only with no third-party executable vendored
targeted tests, full BADF repository checks, and composed-tree verification pass before merge
permissions: read: public external methodology sources for provenance only

rollback.method: revert the eventual squash commit through a separate PR

note: Issue/branch use the human-facing BADF-WP-G01-001 label; this machine work-package record uses the repository schema-compatible canonical WP-2026-0025 identity.
